entities.summary: The Vachnadziani All Holy, or Vachnadziani Monastery is an old monastery Georgian Orthodox near the Vachnadziani village in the Gurjaani Municipality, eastern of Georgia. The main church of the named after All Saints monastery was the Mother Church of the 9th century.
